readings.Aries: There is a version of this situation that doesn't require you to fight. Try to find it. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Taurus: The plan you've been executing is yours. Make sure the goal still is. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Gemini: You contain multitudes and you know it. Today, pick one and inhabit it fully. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Cancer: The person you're worried about knows you're worried. Say it out loud instead. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Leo: The applause you remember most is the one that surprised you. Aim for that. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Virgo: Your care for the people around you is expressed in actions, not words. Make sure they know it. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Libra: The comparison you keep making — between now and then, between here and there — is distorting what's in front of you. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Scorpio: You contain multitudes of darkness and light and you've learned not to be afraid of either. Teach someone. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Sagittarius: The adventure was real. The integration of it is the next adventure. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Capricorn: The structure you've built is load-bearing in ways you haven't fully mapped. Don't remove anything without knowing what it supports. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Aquarius: Your version of intimacy is unusual and real. Someone is trying to understand it. Help them. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Pisces: The current is strong today. You can swim with it and choose your direction within it. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
